title: Grateful Dead Live at St. Paul Auditorium on 1973-02-17
lineage: DAT/0 (Tascam DA-40) > Tascam DA-3000 > Samplitude Pro X5 Suite > FLAC
source: SBD > Reel Master (7.5ips 1/2trk) > Reel/1 (7.5ips/Dolby B) > DAT/0 (Panasonic SV-3800/48k)

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard upgrade captures a high‑energy ’73 show with white‑hot Jerry runs, Phil on fire, and a monster HCS→China→Rider jam.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about this Saint Paul 1973 performance, highlighting the first‑set climax of “Playing in the Band,” a scorching dark‑star tease, and a legendary “He’s Gone → China Cat Sunflower → Rider” sandwich with Jerry’s out‑of‑body solo. The Miller‑fixed soundboard source is praised for its clarity and upgrade quality, making the show a vivid listening experience.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviews give 5 stars and provide detailed praise of both musical performance and upgraded soundboard quality, leading to a high combined rating despite the small sample size.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Miller’s fixed upgrade is praised; no complaints about clarity or mix, indicating a crisp, well‑balanced recording.

standout_songs: He’s Gone → China Cat Sunflower → Rider
show_quality.setlist_flow: First set builds to a powerful “Playing” climax; second set opens with “Truckin’” and delivers a monumental jam sequence, maintaining tightness while staying wild.

band_member_comments.Jerry: White‑hot runs throughout; his solo in the HCS→China→Rider sandwich is described as near out‑of‑body.
band_member_comments.Phil: On fire, driving the band’s energy especially during “Playing”.
